description.name: SMSTunnel: codes by text message
description.tagline: Sign-in codes by text message, sent from your own Android phone with SMSTunnel.
description.long: A Two-Factor Authentication module for staff and clients: each sign-in texts a 6-digit code to the mobile number the person confirmed when turning it on. Codes expire after 10 minutes, work once, allow 5 tries, and are stored only as keyed hashes. Needs the SMSTunnel for WHMCS addon.
features: 6-digit codes valid for 10 minutes, one use, 5 tries
The number is confirmed with a code before it is saved
Codes are never logged or stored in clear
